name: Multiresolution Volume Rendering
aliases: Direct rendering of multiresolution decomposed volume data
Multiresolution Volume Rendering with Adaptive Integration
definition: A rendering method that uses multiresolution decomposition (wavelet or Laplacian pyramid) of volume data to perform adaptive integration and early termination. It allows using lower resolution data for parts of the ray where accuracy requirements are lower or occlusion is high, reducing computational cost.
summary: Multiresolution Volume Rendering is a direct volume ray casting technique that uses hierarchical data decomposition to adaptively switch resolution levels, reducing computational cost while maintaining high fidelity.
